body.message:
For the first 3 months, we can offer a rate of AED 5,500 per month.

For the following 3 months, the rates will be:
August: AED 6,000
September: AED 6,500
October: AED 7,500

So, the first 3 months will be at the same rate of AED 5,500, and the next 3 months will follow the above pricing.
